from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyDilutedEPS(BaseModel):
    """Diluted Earnings Per Share reported in one company's financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="Diluted EPS value; positive for gain, negative for loss, 0 for zero")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    eps_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g., 'Basic and Diluted Loss Per Share', 'Diluted Earnings Per Share')")
    notes: str | None = Field(description="Any notes about the calculation (e.g., 'diluted shares anti-dilutive')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt anchoring the EPS figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_diluted_eps: list[CompanyDilutedEPS]
